about_the_game:
Welcome to MeadowMeld

A cozy colony sim about hybrid animals, heartwarming choices, and the memories you make along the way. Breed, build, and nurture a village where every creature matters.

Breed and Discover

Combine animals to create charming, never-before-seen hybrids - each with unique traits, appearances, and abilities that pass down to future generations. Will you raise a bee-cat, a donkey-eagle-sheep-peacock, or something entirely new?

Build and Optimize

Assign workers, plan building placement, and master adjacency bonuses. Every tile and trait can turn the tide for your village.

Nurture Relationships

Shape the bonds between your animals with MeadowMeld’s unique Heart, Mind, and Soul systems. Foster friendships, resolve rivalries, and watch your colony come alive.

Shape Your Story

Every choice you make - who to breed, which path to follow, how you honor your loved ones - leaves a legacy. Celebrate, remember, and create your own tale with every playthrough.

Behind the Scenes

This is still early in development - what you’re seeing now is mostly the animal breeding system, which is the foundation of the game.

But MeadowMeld isn’t just about cute hybrids - it’s about building something meaningful with them. Over time, you’ll guide your animal villagers through resource decisions, cozy village life, emotional quests, and hard choices about who stays, who goes, and what kind of leader you want to be.

Wishlist now to be notified when demo builds and the full release are available.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / GTX 660 / Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Raise a thriving colony of unique hybrid animals - breed and build for satisfying genetic traits while nurturing moods and relationships. Choose to lead with Heart, Mind or Soul through each chapter. Decisions and events ripple through time - each MeadowMeld village is uniquely yours.
